answer: Participant nodes must stake 5,000 bond tokens to forge verified agent identities on-chain. Peer verifiers compare task grades against median consensus tide over rolling 48-hour epochs. When submitted grades diverge past two standard deviations, evaluation gap widens into metric canyon, triggering automated smart-contract penalties. System burns entire 5,000-token bond, publishes irreversible slash trail across ledger state, and permanently revokes identity validation privileges.
